summary: The label line of a direct command (/ command or entity action) now carries {{mention:…}} markers for the command and each picked object: the chat shows pills, the approval card names the picked object, and later model turns see these ids as for any mention.
howTo: Nothing to do with the built-in bubble. Code that reads the label line itself (parseChatCommandMessage(text).label, stored user messages) now gets {{mention:command:<id>:<label>}} and {{mention:<type>:<id>:<label>}} instead of /Label @Name: render it with parseMentionSegments or parseMentionMarkers, as for composer mentions. Old messages keep their plain line. A value without a picked label, an argument without an entity type and an id with : stay plain text; the line stays at most 200 characters and is never cut inside a marker. An own PendingChatCommand for an entity action can set valueTypes (argument name to entity type) so its target is shown as a pill. See docs/chat-interactions.md, What happens on send.
